equipment.help.dryer.capacitySpools: How many spools fit in the dryer at once.
equipment.help.dryer.maxC: The highest temperature you can set. If the dryer works at only one temperature, both values are the same.
equipment.help.dryer.minC: The lowest temperature you can set. On the spec sheet it's the first value of “Temperature range”.
equipment.help.dryer.name: The dryer's model name (on the box or the manufacturer's page). Informational only.
equipment.help.dryer.powerW: The dryer's power in watts (on the rating plate or spec sheet). Informational only.
equipment.help.dryer.zones: How many spools can be dried independently, each with its own temperature and timer. A simple dryer has 1.
equipment.help.printer.buildVolume: The size of the build volume, e.g. “256 × 256 × 256 mm”. Informational only.
equipment.help.printer.enclosed: Does the machine have a door or housing that encloses the print area? If it's closed on the sides and the top, answer yes; for an open or frame-only machine, no.
equipment.help.printer.hardenedNozzle: Is there a hardened steel or other wear-resistant nozzle in the machine (not brass)? Needed for carbon- and glass-fiber materials. If you're not sure, leave it on “don't know”.
equipment.help.printer.heatedChamber: Active heating of the chamber – not just the bed warming up an enclosed space. On the spec sheet: “Heated chamber” or “Active chamber heating”. If only the bed heats the space, answer no.
equipment.help.printer.heatedToolheads: How many toolheads (nozzles) can be heated independently. Most machines have 1; multi-head or tool-changer machines have more.
equipment.help.printer.maxBedC: The highest temperature of the heated bed (spec sheet: “Max. bed temperature”). Typical value: 100–120 °C.
equipment.help.printer.maxChamberC: The highest temperature the chamber can be set to (spec sheet: “Max. chamber temperature”). Fill it in only for a heated chamber; typical value: 45–65 °C.
equipment.help.printer.maxNozzleC: The highest temperature the nozzle (hotend) is allowed to reach. On the manufacturer's spec sheet it's called “Max. nozzle temperature”; most machines manage 260–300 °C.
equipment.help.printer.name: The machine's model name, e.g. on the box or the manufacturer's page. For your reference only; it isn't used in the calculation.
equipment.printer.name: Printer model (name)

equipment.sub: Your printer and dryer details – the Tuttirial labels are calculated from them.
equipment.why.body: Enter your printer and dryer details and the Tuttirial shows, for every filament type, how well it suits your machine: “Ideal for your machine”, “Works well”, “Borderline” or “Not printable” – with the reasons. From the dryer details we also warn you if a material's drying temperature is out of your dryer's range. Every field is optional: leave blank what you don't know, we never invent a value. The data is stored only on this computer.

fit.reason.bed.most: Bed: needs {lo}–{hi} °C, your printer reaches {max} °C – most of the range is covered but not the top.
fit.reason.bed.ok: Bed: needs {lo}–{hi} °C, your printer reaches {max} °C – a comfortable margin.
fit.reason.bed.partial: Bed: needs {lo}–{hi} °C, your printer only reaches {max} °C – only the lower half of the range is available.
fit.reason.bed.tight: Bed: needs {lo}–{hi} °C, your printer reaches {max} °C – fine, but at the top of the range the bed runs at its limit.
fit.reason.bed.tooLow: Bed: needs at least {lo} °C, your printer reaches {max} °C at most.
fit.reason.bed.unknown: Bed: needs {lo}–{hi} °C, but you have not entered your printer's max. bed temperature.
fit.reason.chamber.activeLow: Chamber: at least {lo} °C is recommended, your heated chamber reaches {max} °C – larger parts may warp.
fit.reason.chamber.activeOk: Chamber: your heated chamber ({max} °C) suits this material.
fit.reason.chamber.activeUnknownMax: Chamber: you have a heated chamber, but you have not entered its maximum temperature.
fit.reason.chamber.open.recommended: Chamber: a heated chamber is recommended, and your printer is open – try small parts in a draught-free place.
fit.reason.chamber.open.required: Chamber: this material needs a heated chamber, and your printer is open.
fit.reason.chamber.passive.recommended: Chamber: a heated chamber is recommended; your enclosed build space helps a lot even without heating.
fit.reason.chamber.passive.required: Chamber: this material needs a heated chamber; your printer is enclosed but not heated – small parts may work, larger ones can warp or crack.
fit.reason.chamber.unheated.recommended: Chamber: a heated chamber is recommended and your printer has none; you have not said whether it is enclosed.
fit.reason.chamber.unheated.required: Chamber: this material needs a heated chamber and your printer has none; you have not said whether it is enclosed.
fit.reason.chamber.unknown.recommended: Chamber: a heated chamber is recommended, but you have not entered anything about your printer's chamber.
fit.reason.chamber.unknown.required: Chamber: this material needs a heated chamber, but you have not entered anything about your printer's chamber.
fit.reason.difficulty: A demanding material: your printer can handle it, but printing it takes practice and tuning.
fit.reason.dryer.tooCool: Dryer: the recommended drying temperature is {need} °C, your dryer reaches {max} °C at most – dry for longer at the lower temperature.
fit.reason.dryer.tooHot: Dryer: the recommended drying temperature is {need} °C, your dryer's lowest setting is {min} °C – that may be too hot for this material.
fit.reason.dryer.unknown: Dryer: the recommended drying temperature is {need} °C, but you have not entered your dryer's temperature range.
fit.reason.hardened.missing: Nozzle material: this is an abrasive material and needs a hardened nozzle – it wears out a brass nozzle quickly.
fit.reason.hardened.ok: Nozzle material: this is an abrasive material, and your printer has a hardened nozzle.
fit.reason.hardened.unknown: Nozzle material: this is an abrasive material and needs a hardened nozzle – you have not said whether your printer has one.
fit.reason.insufficient: Enter your printer's max. nozzle and bed temperature so we can tell how well this material suits it.
fit.reason.nozzle.most: Nozzle: needs {lo}–{hi} °C, your printer reaches {max} °C – most of the range is covered but not the top; brands that need more heat may be a problem.
fit.reason.nozzle.ok: Nozzle: needs {lo}–{hi} °C, your printer reaches {max} °C – a comfortable margin.
fit.reason.nozzle.partial: Nozzle: needs {lo}–{hi} °C, your printer only reaches {max} °C – only the lower half of the range is available.
fit.reason.nozzle.tight: Nozzle: needs {lo}–{hi} °C, your printer reaches {max} °C – fine, but at the top of the range the printer runs at its limit.
fit.reason.nozzle.tooLow: Nozzle: needs at least {lo} °C, your printer reaches {max} °C at most.
fit.reason.nozzle.unknown: Nozzle: needs {lo}–{hi} °C, but you have not entered your printer's max. nozzle temperature.
